sources.title: SenseVoiceSmall: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview SenseVoiceSmall is a multilingual speech understanding model built by FunAudioLLM that handles automatic speech recognition (ASR), spoken language identification (LID), speech emotion recognition (SER), and audio event detection (AED) in a single encoder-only framework.
